clear sky noun

also clear weather, fine weather, clear (unclouded), unclouded

classical

Verg. G. 4.77, sūdus
Traupman 292: sūdus -a -um

sūdum, sūdī n.

noun, second declension

a clear, bright sky

Other words

  • serēnitās, serēnitātis f. — clear weather

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 135; Cic. Div. 2.94; Traupman 315

  • serēnus, serēna, serēnum — clear, unclouded (of the sky)

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 292

Examples

  • Nunc sūdum est,» inquit, «et invītat ad deambulandum.

    The sky is clear now,” he said, “and it’s a day for a walk.Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

  • Puer Alpēs summā serēnitāte cōnspexit

    The boy saw the Alps in perfectly clear weatherLibellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

See also clear up, sunny.
